literal: Unblossomed flower - inside the bud - that which is - fragrance - like - innocent girl's - smile - inside the bud - that which is - something - exists.
translation: Just as fragrance lies hidden within an unblossomed bud, there is a hidden meaning within the budding smile of this innocent girl.
modern: மலராத மொட்டுக்குள் மணம் மறைந்திருப்பது போல, இந்தப் பேதைப் பெண்ணின் புன்னகை மொட்டுக்குள்ளும் ஒரு குறிப்பு மறைந்துள்ளது.
explanation: The speaker observes the subtle smile of the heroine and realizes it carries a hidden message. He compares her smile to a flower bud (முகை மொக்கு). Just as a closed bud holds its fragrance (நாற்றம், which means a pleasant scent in classical Tamil) inside until it blooms, the innocent girl's (பேதை) budding smile (நகை மொக்கு) conceals her true feelings. The repetition of 'மொக்குள் உள்ளது' (that which is inside the bud) beautifully parallels the hidden scent of the flower with the hidden intent of her smile.
